descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S07 「养老院就诊次数 0 / 1 / 3 / 4，带跳过的日子」 Nursing Home visit counts 0 / 1 / 3 / 4, with skipped days

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated.（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 AC 3）
  • U4 Nursing Home: entries are keyed by visit number and labelled 'Visit N – date'.（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 AC 5）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Four seeded residents. R0: no course. R1: one visit (<day-4>). R3: visits on <day-4>, <day-2> and <day0> (day-3 and day-1 skipped). R4: four visits (<day-6>, <day-4>, <day-2>, <day0>)

When Open each resident's Pre-Round tab and look at the Visit Timeline (view only)

Then R0: no visit entry and no filler line. R1: 'Visit 1 – <day-4>'. R3: Visits 2 and 3 in date order, nothing for day-3 or day-1. R4: Visits 3 and 4 in order. Whether R3 Visit 1 and R4 Visits 1–2 must still show depends on Q5 (all / last 3 / last 2)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint, scoped to the Visit Timeline. The display label 'Visit N – <date>' is judged, not the stored '·'. Only visits shown under every Q5 reading are judged (R3 Visits 2–3, R4 Visits 3–4); R3 Visit 1 and R4 Visits 1–2 go in notJudged (Q5). …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U04；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-11.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
